osworld2.notesShort: OpenAI self-reported at the GPT-5.6 launch; single-agent Sol (ultra multi-agent not reported on OSWorld 2.0). Partial score; binary completion not published. New state of the art.
Author-run on the official OSWorld 2.0 harness (108 long-horizon tasks); max thinking with batched tool calls, 500-step budget. 20.6% binary completion.
Author-run; xhigh reasoning with batched tool calls, 500-step budget (~$2,750 per run). 13.0% binary completion, flat across 150/300/500 steps.
Author-run; max thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget. 18.52% binary completion. Batched tool calls lift the same model to 54.8% partial (rank 2).
Author-run; max thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$3,870 per run). 13.9% binary completion.
Author-run; max thinking with batched tool calls, 500-step budget. 18.2% binary completion.
Author-run; max thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$2,410 per run). 8.3% binary completion.
Author-run; medium thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$1,550 per run). 9.3% binary completion (higher binary than max thinking).
Author-run; reasoning enabled, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$259 per run). 4.6% binary completion.
Author-run; reasoning enabled, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$708 per run). 4.6% binary completion.
Author-run; thinking mode, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$412 per run). 2.8% binary completion.
